edits.current: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. SOURCE: wage types 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (authorised partial payments) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here.
edits.proposed: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. SOURCE: wage types 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (authorised partial payments) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here. An employee on integral salary (WT 62140 Integral Salary) accrues no cesantias and no interest for the time on integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 2), so nothing is certified here for that time, including on termination; only cesantias and interest settled for the service before the conversion to integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 4) are certified here. The integral salary itself is certified in full in casilla 36. Interest on cesantias is paid with every direct payment of cesantias - WT 62117 on termination, or within the month following a partial settlement (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1) - and not only as the January interest of WT 62127.
